name: FP Counter
description: Record a run and automatically find and mark every frame perfect click.

min-fps.name: Lowest FPS to mark
min-fps.description: Clicks whose window is this tight or tighter get a circle. 60 marks 60, 80, 120 and 240 fps frame perfects. Lower values (e.g. 30) also mark looser clicks but make analysis slower.

horizon.name: Survival check (ticks)
horizon.description: How long (in 1/240 s physics ticks) the player must survive after a shifted click for that timing to count as OK. 120 = half a second.

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases
analyze-releases.description: Also check how precise each release is (matters for ship, wave, swing and UFO holds). Doubles the work.

fast-converge.name: Fast mode
fast-converge.description: Stop a test early once the player is back in exactly the same state as the original run. Much faster; turn off if results look wrong.

budget-ms.name: Analysis speed (ms per frame)
budget-ms.description: How much of each frame the analyser may use. Higher is faster but the game gets choppier while analysing.

show-markers.name: Show markers
show-markers.description: Draw a circle with the FPS value at every frame perfect click.

show-hud.name: Show FP counter
show-hud.description: Show the number of frame perfects per FPS tier in the top-left corner.
